many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

    seen=np.zeros_like(g,bool); out=[]; H,W=g.shape

import numpy as np, os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
# Hypothesis: for every row, let lc = index of rightmost nonzero; fill bg cells immediately right of it (if lc+1 <= W-1) ... but must exclude cases where run >=3. Test both hypotheses.
def solve(grid, mode='fill-run'):
    a=np.array(grid); bg=Counter(a.flatten()).most_common(1)[0][0]; H,W=a.shape
    o=a.copy()
    for i in range(H):
        nz=[j for j,x in enumerate(a[i]) if x!=bg]
        if not nz: continue
        lc=max(nz); run=W-lc-1
        if mode=='fill-run' and 1<=run<=2:
            for c in range(lc+1,W): o[i,c]=1
        elif mode=='always':
            for c in range(lc+1,W): o[i,c]=1
    return o
for mode in ['fill-run','always']:
    bad=False
    for name,bgin in [('Demo pair 1',True),('Demo pair 2',False)]:
        gi=G[name+' input']; go=np.array(G[name+' output'])
        got=solve(gi,mode)
        if np.array_equal(got,go): print(name,'mode',mode,'MATCH'); continue
        # find mismatch locations
        mm=np.argwhere(got!=go)
        print(mode,name,'MISMATCH',sorted(map(tuple,mm)))
    # also verify against known-diff sets directly by checking predicted diffs == actual diffs
def direct_check():
    res=[]
    for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
        gi=np.array(G[name+' input']); go=np.array(G[name+' output'])
        pred=np.argwhere(solve(gi,'fill-run')!=gi)
        act=np.argwhere(go!=gi)
        pred=set(map(tuple,pred)); act=set(map(tuple,act))
        res.append((name,pred==act,act-pred))
    return res
print(direct_check())

import os,re,numpy as np,collections, json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def find_period(seq):
    # minimal period p of sequence seq (len L) - choose smallest p with few conflicts
    best=None
    for p in range(1,len(seq)):
        bad=sum(1 for i in range(p-1,len(seq)) if seq[i]!=seq[i-p])
        if best is None or bad<best[1]: best=(p,bad)
    return best[0],best[1]

for n in range(1,7):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; go=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} output']); inp=np.array(gi); H,W=inp.shape

        ch=collections.Counter(s)

import os,re,numpy as np,collections
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def find_period(seq):
    L=len(seq); best=None
    for p in range(1,pow(L/2)):
        bad=sum(1 for i in range(p,L) if seq[i]!=seq[i%p])
        if best is None or bad<best[1]: best=(p,bad)
    return best[0],best[1]

import os,re,numpy as np,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def bands_of(g):
    g=np.array(g); H,W=g.shape
    bg=Counter(g.ravel()).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows=[r for r in range(H) if (g[r]!=bg).any()]
    runs=[];cur=[]
    for r in rows:
        if cur and r>cur[-1]+1: runs.append(cur); cur=[]
        cur.append(r)
    runs.append(cur)
    return runs,bg
def solve(g):
    g=np.array(g); runs,bg=bands_of(g)
    if len(runs)<2: return g.tolist()
    b1,b2=runs[0][0],runs[-1][0]
    h1=h2=len(runs[0]); w=g.shape[1]
    src=(g[b1:b2+h1]!=bg).astype(int); tgt=(g[b2:b2+h2]!=bg).astype(int)
    best=None
    out=g.copy()
    for dx in range(-w,w+1):
        pos=np.argwhere(src[:,dx:dx+w]*0)
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h1) for c in range(w) if 0<=c-dx<w and src[r,c] and not tgt[r,c-dx]]
        nmis=[(r,c) for r in range(h1) for c in range(w) if 0<=c-dx<w and src[r,c]!=tgt[r,c-dx]]
        cnt=sum(0 for _ in [pts])
        if best is None or (len(nmis)<=best[0] or True):
            pass
        # score: number of fg in src NOT covered in tgt after shift
        ok=sum(not tgt[r,c-dx] for r in range(h1) for c in range(w) if 0<=c-dx<w and src[r,c])
        if best is None or ok<best[0]: best=(ok,dx)
    ok,dx=best
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h1) for c in range(w) if 0<=c-dx<w and src[r,c] and not tgt[r,c-dx]]
    fgcol=int(g[b1][np.where(src[b1])==True][0])
    for r,c in pts:
        out[r,c]=fgcol
    return out.tolist()
for n in range(1,9):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; go=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
    pred=np.array(solve(gi))
    print(n, 'match' if pred.shape==go.shape and (pred==go).all() else 'FAIL', int((pred!=go).sum()))
